_what_this_is: An example record for Content/Python/task_phase.py. It exists so the ladder has a worked example, and so a new record can be copied from something that passes rather than from prose.
_copy_this_not_that: Copy the shape, not the states. A copied record that arrives with the same states is a record that reports progress nobody made, which is the failure the checker exists to catch.
